limits: Static fixed-camera ribbons, not native curves; retained groom control points are not loaded directly at runtime
No dynamics or global self-intersection/collision solver; mannequin is an original stylized fixture
Bounded procedural knit appearance; explicit yarn tubes are unrelaxed and garment joins overlap
Hair BDPT and cloth/hair photon mapping are outside validated scope
Knit UV filtering not implemented; distant high-density patterns may alias
Backend consistency is not independent Blender/PBRT appearance accuracy
OIDN can smooth fine strands; numerical checks always use raw PFM
Vulkan tested via MoltenVK on Apple M4; no Khronos layer on this machine
Render timings and native pipeline cold compile are separate; no efficiency comparison
